localidad: Western slopes of the Cordillera Central; Quindío Plateu; Department of Quindío, Circasia, Vereda Membrillal, RNSC Bosque del Silencio Reserve; on ther. northern bank of the Roble river.
comentarios:
The couple was seen near a road, in an open area surrounding a forest reserve of about 4 ha.  The nearest bird was on a branch ∼1-2 m from the floor. The farthest bird was just on the border of the forest, some like 5 m above the floor level. The couple was very tolerant with my presence, so much so that I was able to get close to one of the individuals as much as about 3 m away.

Note: The recording was edited in Ocean Audio. I supressed some abrupt sounds between the calls. I normalized it to - 3 db. The recording format (mp3) was  converted into .WAV.
